problem.heading: Hospitality teams are still doing this the hard way
problem.subheading: Manual comparison, disconnected properties and quiet vendor bias are costing you money on every order.

points.title: Comparing quotes takes days
points.description: Copy-pasting numbers out of PDFs and email threads into spreadsheets is slow and manual, and the best rate is easy to miss when it is buried in the line items.

points.title: The same item, two different rates
points.description: Two properties in the same group unknowingly pay different prices for identical stock, because nobody has visibility across the whole estate.

points.title: Relationships decide the award
points.description: Long-standing vendor relationships quietly influence who wins, so the sharpest price does not always take the order.

solution.heading: One system, from requisition to final payment
solution.subheading: Purpose-built so you always know the right price — everywhere, from everyone.

points.title: AI price comparison, line by line
points.description: Every quote is normalised the moment it lands and plotted side by side, so the best rate across vendors is obvious in seconds rather than spreadsheets.

points.title: One item, one rate, every property
points.description: The same item carries the same negotiated rate across your entire group, so no property overpays for something another one already sourced cheaper.

points.title: Vendor masking
points.description: Identities stay hidden through technical evaluation, so bids are scored on specification and clause compliance alone. Commercials stay sealed until that scoring is signed off.

offerings.heading: Four ways hospitality groups buy
offerings.subheading: Every kind of spend a hotel group runs, on one platform — from the daily kitchen order to fitting out a brand new property.

items.title: Daily Procurement
items.description: The everyday run of provisions, housekeeping and F&B consumables. Raise a requirement, collect quotes and release the order the same day, against the rate you already negotiated.

items.title: Annual Rate Contracts
items.description: Lock a rate per item for the year and hold it across every property. Each order is checked against the contract the day it is raised, so agreed pricing is what actually gets paid.

items.title: Renovation Project Procurement
items.description: Tender-led buying for refurbishment, with technical evaluation, multi-round negotiation and staged approvals tracked against the project budget.

items.title: New Unit Setup Procurement
items.description: Fitting out a new property end to end — bulk sourcing across categories, phased delivery against the opening date, and a full audit trail for the capex.

journey.heading: Three steps, end to end
journey.subheading: From raising a requirement to paying the vendor, with every quote, round and approval tracked along the way.

steps.title: Raise an RFQ or tender
steps.description: Build it from your item master in minutes. Publish to your suppliers straight away, or schedule it for a later date.

steps.title: Compare and negotiate
steps.description: Negotiate on any field — unit price, packaging, freight, taxes, documents — across as many rounds as you need.

steps.title: Issue the PO, track to payment
steps.description: Convert the winning quote into a purchase order, route it through your property's approval chain, and follow it through GRN to payment.

whatYouGet.heading: What your procurement team gets
whatYouGet.subheading: Everything needed to buy better across every property, without adding headcount.

benefits.title: Lower procurement cost
benefits.description: Putting every quote in open competition on price and specification consistently takes 6-9% off what you were paying before.

benefits.title: Faster turnaround
benefits.description: Quote collection and comparison that used to take days now happens in hours, so operations stop waiting on procurement.

benefits.title: Negotiation built into the flow
benefits.description: Run structured negotiation rounds with target prices against every shortlisted quote, so the saving is captured before the PO is raised.

benefits.title: Visibility and control
benefits.description: See the live status of every RFQ, tender, negotiation and PO across all your properties from a single dashboard.

benefits.title: A clean audit trail
benefits.description: Every quote, revision, approval and comment is timestamped and stored, so audits stop being a scramble.

benefits.title: Dedicated support
benefits.description: Onboarding, rollout across properties and day-to-day help from a team that knows hospitality procurement.

items.quote: WorkWise gave us one rate across every property and complete transparency in vendor evaluation. Our procurement is now faster, cleaner and far easier to control.
